reason: I already get my views, watch time and click-through in YouTube Studio for free, and vidIQ shows me trends too. I can't see what another ₹99 a month would tell me that I'm not already checking myself.
objection: Tools don't grow channels. Consistency and luck do, and a paid AI coach that reads my own numbers back to me doesn't change what I post next week.
would_change_my_mind: If a free try on my own channel gave me a specific, checkable reason a video underperformed and a title or thumbnail change that actually beat my usual views.
